tischendorf-lxx: Constantin von Tischendorf, ed., Vetus Testamentum Graece iuxta LXX interpretes (Leipzig), the Sixtine text of 1587 (based on Codex Vaticanus), with the readings of A, א and C; digitized copy dated 1877
whedbee-comedy-job: J. William Whedbee, "The Comedy of Job," Semeia 7 (1977): 1–39
mccarthy-tiqqune: Carmel McCarthy, The Tiqqune Sopherim and Other Theological Corrections in the Masoretic Text of the Old Testament, Orbis Biblicus et Orientalis 36 (1981)
midrash-tanhuma: Midrash Tanhuma, a rabbinic midrash on the Torah (compiled about AD 500–800)
ag-fundamental-truths: Assemblies of God, Statement of Fundamental Truths (adopted 1916; revised)
jerome-job-hexaplaric: Jerome, Liber Iob, his Latin translation of Origen's hexaplaric Greek of Job, keeping Origen's asterisks and obeli, in J.-P. Migne, ed., Patrologia Latina 29, from Vallarsi's edition with Martianay's notes
jordanville-prayer-book: A Prayer Book for Orthodox Christians (Holy Trinity Monastery, Jordanville, New York), including the Canon of Supplication to the Guardian Angel
